seoTitle: How to Pass Stripe Fees to Your Customer
metaDescription: Adjust your pricing to pass Stripe processing fees to customers with surcharges while staying compliant and transparent.
intro: If Stripe's processing fees are eating into your margins, you may want to shift that cost to the customer instead of absorbing it yourself. This guide covers practical ways to calculate Stripe fees, add surcharges, and build them into your pricing, along with important compliance considerations.

steps.heading: Calculate your Stripe processing fees
steps.body: Work out exactly what percentage and fixed fee Stripe charges per transaction so you know how much to pass along.

steps.heading: Decide on a surcharge or built-in pricing method
steps.body: Choose whether to add a visible surcharge at checkout or simply build the fee into your product or service price.

steps.heading: Set up the surcharge in your checkout flow
steps.body: Configure your store or invoicing system to automatically apply the calculated fee to each transaction.

steps.heading: Review compliance rules
steps.body: Check the surcharge regulations in your region and card network rules, since some countries and card types restrict adding surcharges.

steps.heading: Communicate transparently with customers
steps.body: Make sure customers can clearly see any added fee before completing their purchase to maintain trust.

faq.question: Is it legal to pass Stripe fees to customers?
faq.answer: This depends on your country and the card network's rules, since some regions restrict or regulate surcharging, so it's worth checking local regulations.

faq.question: Will Stripe automatically calculate the surcharge for me?
faq.answer: Stripe doesn't automatically add surcharges by default, so you'll typically need to calculate and apply the fee yourself in your pricing or checkout setup.

faq.question: Does passing on fees affect customer trust?
faq.answer: It can, which is why being transparent about any added surcharge before checkout is important for maintaining customer trust.

faq.question: Can I just increase my prices instead of adding a visible fee?
faq.answer: Yes, building the fee into your base price is an alternative to a visible surcharge and avoids some surcharge compliance requirements.
